title: Maiorana–McFarland construction
statement: Given a function $g$ from the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to the signs, define a real-valued function on the Boolean cube of dimension $2n$ by splitting each input into two $n$-dimensional blocks, taking the inner product modulo two of those blocks, and multiplying its sign character by the sign value of $g$ evaluated at the second block.
